name: dashboard-language
description: Add a language to the training dashboard (the assistant translates its texts)

arguments.name: language
arguments.description: The language, e.g. German; empty = the language of this chat

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: The dashboard file, e.g. garmin-dashboard-coach.html; empty = the default page

name: dashboard-setup
description: Set up a dashboard: title, sports, the data it shows (e.g. for a coach), languages, themes, file

arguments.name: weeks
arguments.description: Number of weeks to cover, default 12

name: dashboard-widget
description: Make a new widget for the training dashboard from your idea

arguments.name: idea
arguments.description: What the widget shows, e.g. my longest ride each month

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: The dashboard file, e.g. garmin-dashboard-coach.html; empty = the default page

name: race-readiness
description: Check if you are ready for a race: training block, taper, predicted time, recovery, race plan

arguments.name: distance
arguments.description: 5k, 10k, half, marathon, or a distance in km

arguments.name: goal
arguments.description: Your goal time, e.g. 1:45:00; empty = no goal

name: run-review
description: Review a run as a coach: planned workout against the laps, rep fade, HR drift, recovery

arguments.name: activity
arguments.description: An activity id, or words of its name; empty = the latest run

name: strength-review
description: Review a strength session as a coach: planned sets against done, top sets, rest, recovery

arguments.name: activity
arguments.description: An activity id, or words of its name; empty = the latest strength session

name: training-dashboard
description: Build a personal training + recovery dashboard (volume, load, HRV, sleep) from Garmin data

arguments.name: weeks
arguments.description: Number of weeks to cover, default 12

arguments.name: layout
arguments.description: preset (default): the built-in widgets; blank: an empty grid; freeform: the assistant designs the whole page

name: training-dashboard-update
description: Update the training dashboard with the new Garmin data; it keeps the layout, widgets and languages

arguments.name: weeks
arguments.description: Weeks to cover; empty = keep the weeks of the dashboard

arguments.name: path
arguments.description: The dashboard file, e.g. garmin-dashboard-coach.html; empty = the default page
